title: 末日战役 / Doomsday Battle
direction: Deep space. Two thousand kilometre-long warships hang in a perfect rectangular formation, proud and certain of victory. A single mirror-smooth teardrop probe, 3.4 metres long, ignites a ring of light at its tail and punches through the first row ship after ship; each ship becomes a small sun. Then it turns at impossible angles and takes the fleet apart. Musical arc: hubris -> cold stillness -> mechanical, accelerating annihilation -> desolation. Palette: slow wide choir/brass-like pad in C minor for the fleet (noble, almost a hymn); a pure sine/glass-harmonica tone for the droplet (inhuman, perfectly in tune, no vibrato); pounding low drums and a relentless ostinato that accelerates through the battle; ends on the droplet's cold tone alone.

sections.name: title
sections.note: black screen title. Low sustained C, a distant slow swell.

sections.name: fleet
sections.note: a slow pass along one warship, then at 8.6s a cut to the whole lattice of 2000 ships. Noble, wide hymn-like pad, slow chord changes every 3 seconds, growing confident.

sections.name: droplet
sections.note: macro shot of the mirror teardrop. The hymn stops dead. A single pure cold tone, very quiet, plus faint high shimmer.

sections.name: ignition
sections.note: a halo of light ignites behind the droplet. Riser into the first strike.

sections.name: firstrow
sections.note: the droplet pierces the first row; seen from further down the row, the explosions march toward camera until the nearest ship goes at 30.0s. Drums land on the listed hits, which accelerate. Relentless low ostinato in 16ths.

sections.name: turn
sections.note: wide shot: a string of suns; the droplet makes a sharp turn and takes the next rows. Driving, the hymn chords return distorted and minor.

sections.name: rout
sections.note: the fleet scatters, engines flaring; chase through the fireballs. Peak intensity, fastest ostinato, layered impacts.

sections.name: aftermath
sections.note: a dark red cloud of cooling metal; the droplet hangs unmarked in front of it. Everything drops away to the cold pure tone and a very low rumble.

sections.name: endcard
sections.note: end card. Cold tone fades to silence by 61.5s.
